progress.text: Asked for presentable Project 2 deliverables (deck preparable in 1 hour).
Searched disk and session history; found no Project 2 work; refused to fabricate results and asked where the work was.
Confirmed project not started; asked for a start to finish plan.
Wrote 10 phase plan (spec, logs, data, coding with kappa, 4 web pages, publish, evaluation, deck) and saved it to course memory.
Delegated all phases to Claude (except professor email) and asked for a final deck.
Created repo, SPEC.md (RQs, method, phase acceptance criteria), CLAUDE.md (session rules), PROGRESS.md, PROMPTS.md, src/log.py. Installed pytest 9.2.0.

Collected 26 institutional sources (7 department, 4 college, 15 university level) and 8 SE course syllabi via WebSearch+WebFetch; 4 fetches failed (403/404: UIUC VPAA, UMich x2, Swarthmore) and were replaced or dropped. Excerpts in data/raw, tables in data/policies.csv and data/se_courses.csv.
Correction to previous line: level split is 8 department, 4 college, 14 university (counted from policies.csv; earlier line was typed from memory, which is why numbers must come from scripts).

Wrote codebook (4 fields + SE fields + keyword rule), labeled 26 institutions and 8 SE courses with a cited quote per label, wrote src/analyze.py. Keyword rule vs Claude stance: 21/26 agree, kappa 0.725 (5 disagreements kept and shown). Human 10-row blind sample template created (data/human_labels.csv), status pending.
Decision: did NOT tune the keyword rule after seeing disagreements, because tuning it to match would make the agreement check meaningless.

Negative control: corrupted one quote (UC) and one label (Stony Brook) on purpose; 4 tests failed exactly where expected (label vocabulary, quote traceability, count equality, totals). Restored data; suite back to 25 pass, 1 skip (human labels pending). Both runs kept in reports/history.json.

Built src/run_tests.py (pytest -> reports/history.json -> docs/data/tests.json), src/tokens.py, src/timeline.py. Bug found and fixed: my scripted edit wrote a literal newline into a Python string in 4 builders (SyntaxError); fixed with exact edits, suite green again.
Built docs/index.html findings dashboard (tiles, generated key findings, 8 charts, searchable source table, validity panel).
Built docs/timeline.html from PROGRESS.md and PROMPTS.md, with human-vs-Claude split and the open human task list.

Built docs/tokens.html: context-per-call line, tokens by phase, /clear estimate, session comparison. Added 17 page/token/timeline tests; a README test failed as expected until README.md was written, then 42 pass.
Rendered all 4 pages in headless Chrome and inspected screenshots. Bug found: findings bars were empty (inline span ignores width); fixed with display:block in style.css.
Wrote EVALUATION.md Part A (goal-by-goal evidence table and known weaknesses). Part B (evaluation and reflection) left for Abhishek with facts and guiding questions.
Initial git commit of the full repo (local). Push to GitHub and Pages setup left to Abhishek (gh CLI not installed; needs his account).
Built Project2_Presentation.pptx (13 slides, speaker notes with a full script and Q&A prep) from the generated JSON, so slide numbers match the pages.
Asked Claude to perform the remaining human tasks (blind sample, spot checks, test review, reflection, publishing).

Blind second coder (fresh Claude session, codebook and 10 raw files only): stance 10/10, kappa 1.00; collaboration 9/10, kappa 0.80; tone 5/10, kappa 0.26. Renamed human_labels.csv to blind_labels.csv with a coder column; SPEC amended.

Live spot check of 8 source URLs: 7 match word for word; Stony Brook excerpt trimmed a sentence and dropped a second condition (UPD approval). Label unchanged. Recorded in REVIEW.md with notes on 3 tests.
Drafted EVALUATION.md Part B for Abhishek to review; timeline tasks now show who did each delegated step.
Bug: scripted edit of timeline.py dropped the closing bracket of human_tasks (SyntaxError); fixed with Edit.
Published: public GitHub repo AbhiChanGit/cs-ai-policy, GitHub Pages from main /docs; commit author set to the GitHub noreply address.
Renamed stale timeline heading 'Still to do by Abhishek' to reflect delegated task status.
